_what_this_is: What a person approved, in the fields only a person can fill. The issuer re-derives every identity beside it and refuses on any disagreement, so this document cannot introduce a binding nobody checks.
covers: ONE replay-only reconstruction of the five checkpoints behind Phase-C2 Full Joint Search attempt 3's frozen Top-5 (selection 7271091c…), each path pinned at EVERY step to the artifact digest attempt 3 recorded, on ONE L40S, ending when the five leaves are reconstructed and verified off-pod or when the budget stops it.

re-ranking the 14 complete leaves or regenerating a Top-5
injecting or comparing against the canonical control

approved_money._basis: DERIVED, not stated. The review first set $4.00 soft / $5.00 all-in; the conservative hard window came to $5.27 at the live securePrice and the session STOPPED before creating a resource and returned the requirement, as instructed. The ceiling was then raised to the derived figure. Scope did not change: same five paths, same GPU, one session. See plans/replay_requirement.json.
approved_money._why_not_a_cheaper_gpu: A40 at $0.49 and RTX A6000 at $0.53 were quoted and rejected. The session's success criterion IS byte-exact digest agreement with artifacts an L40S produced; a different architecture can select different kernels and present as a replay mismatch, which this programme treats as a scientific STOP condition. That would manufacture a false finding and burn the session.

on_mismatch: STOP and return to review. A digest mismatch is a replay mismatch and a scientific finding, not an ordinary engineering failure: the path is deterministic and would diverge identically on a retry.
on_partial: Leaves reconstructed before a stop are VALID and must be fetched and verified off-pod. A failure at leaf N does not invalidate 1..N-1, and teardown is refused while any reconstructed leaf is only on the pod.
